title: Nulvless workspace
description: nulvless/nulvless.jsonc: links a repository to a Nulvless project and describes its Edge Functions.

organization.description: Organization slug. Flags (--org) and NULVLESS_ORG take precedence.

project.description: Project slug. Flags (--project) and NULVLESS_PROJECT take precedence.

functions.description: Settings per Edge Function, keyed by the folder name in nulvless/functions.

name.description: Display name in the console, used when the function is created. Defaults to the slug.

secrets.description: Names of the secrets the function needs. Values are never stored here.
